THE SINDH HIGH DENSITY DEVELOPMENT (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2013
THE SINDH HIGH DENSITY DEVELOPMENT (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2013
SINDH
ACT NO. XLIV OF 2013
AN
ACT
KARACHI, THE 16th SEPTEMBER, 2013
NO.PAS/Legis-B-06/2013-The Sindh High
Density Development Board (Amendment) Bill, 2013 having been passed by the
Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 19th August, 2013 and
assented to by the Governor of Sindh on 26th August,
2013 is hereby published as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh
to amend the Sindh
High Density Development Board Act, 2010.
Preamble.- WHEREAS it is expedient to amend the Sindh
High Density Development Board Act, 2010, in the manner hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby enacted as follows
:-
1. Short title and Commencement.- This Act may
be called the Sindh High Density Development Board
(Amendment) Act, 2013.
(2)
It shall come into force at once.
